# freeaicostcalculator.app

> Free, browser-based LLM API cost calculator. Enter requests/month + avg input/output tokens, pick 1-12 models from a curated catalog of 24 (across 8 providers) plus the entire OpenRouter live catalog of 370+ models, and see per-model monthly cost as a sorted bar chart. Includes flat-plan break-even check vs ChatGPT Plus, ChatGPT Pro, Claude Pro, Claude Max, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. Pure arithmetic, no AI provider calls, no API keys required.

## Key facts

- Workload-driven: 3 inputs (requests/month, avg input tokens, avg output tokens) define the calculation
- Per-request cost = (input tokens × input rate + output tokens × output rate) / 1,000,000
- Monthly cost = per-request × requests-per-month
- Optional 50% prompt-cache discount toggle on input portion (models OpenAI/Anthropic cached-prompt savings)
- Compare 1-12 models in a single sorted bar chart + table
- Flat-plan break-even card: ChatGPT Plus $20, ChatGPT Pro $200, Claude Pro $20, Claude Max $100/$200, Cursor Pro $20, GitHub Copilot $19, with honest "rate-limited chat product, not API access" caveat
- Pricing data baked in (24 curated models, dated) + live OpenRouter catalog (370+ models, fetched on page load with pricing pulled inline from openrouter.ai/api/v1/models)
- No API keys, no signup, no third-party SDKs, no analytics on input
- Workload + selected models persist in localStorage
- Export results as Markdown table or CSV
- Dark mode and offline PWA shell
- Free, no sign-up

## Distinct from freetokencounter.app

freetokencounter.app answers: "this specific text costs X to send to model Y" (per-prompt question). freeaicostcalculator.app answers: "if I run N requests/month at avg M tokens, my total monthly bill is Z across these models" (workload/budgeting question). Different intent, different user moment. The two cross-link naturally — count tokens on a representative prompt, plug those numbers into the calculator to project monthly spend.

## Curated models (priced from each provider's published rates)

- **Anthropic:** Claude Opus 4.7 ($15/$75 per M), Sonnet 4.6 ($3/$15), Haiku 4.5 ($1/$5)
- **Google:** Gemini 2.5 Pro ($1.25/$10), Gemini 2.5 Flash ($0.30/$2.50), Gemini 2.0 Flash ($0.10/$0.40)
- **xAI:** Grok 4 ($5/$15), Grok 4 Fast ($0.20/$0.50), Grok 3 ($3/$15)
- **Mistral:** Large 2 ($2/$6), Medium 3 ($0.40/$2), Small 3.1 ($0.10/$0.30)
- **DeepSeek:** V3.1 ($0.27/$1.10), R1 ($0.55/$2.19)
- **Groq (Llama):** Llama 4 Scout 17B ($0.11/$0.34), Llama 3.3 70B ($0.59/$0.79), Llama 3.1 8B ($0.05/$0.08)
- **Cohere:** Command A ($2.50/$10), Command R+ ($2.50/$10), Command R ($0.15/$0.60)
- **OpenAI via OpenRouter:** GPT-5 ($1.25/$10), GPT-5 mini ($0.25/$2), GPT-4.1 ($3/$12), o4-mini ($1.10/$4.40)

Plus the full live OpenRouter catalog with provider sub-filter (60 providers grouped by prefix) and search.

- [How to budget LLM API spend](https://freeaicostcalculator.app/how-to-budget-llm-api-spend) — educational walkthrough

## Privacy model

freeaicostcalculator.app is a static page. The only outbound network request is a public GET to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models` (no auth, no personal data) to populate the live model catalog. The calculator does not call any AI provider — it is pure arithmetic on baked-in pricing. No keys are required or accepted. No analytics on input.
